:::{#exr-ones-vector-practice}
#### Adding one to every entry with the ones vector

Adding the [ones vector](#def-ones-vector) to a vector raises every entry by $1$,
for example to shift a list of counts that start at $0$ so that they start at $1$.
Let

$$
\vx = \sbmat{2 \\ 0 \\ -1}.
$$

Find $\vx + \v1$,
where $\v1$ has $3$ entries.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Write out $\v1$ with @def-ones-vector,
then use @def-vector-addition.

:::
